text:
{collection}.{field}: node {node} removed from the vocabulary.
Content written with {node} would hold a node the app no longer declares, and the editor binding would refuse an editor that still has it.
Keep {node} in the vocabulary.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a node is removed from a rich-text field's vocabulary.
